detector: manual read of index.html, src/main.tsx, src/contexts/locale-context.tsx, theme.css; rg for prefers-color-scheme/data-theme/dark
evidence: No SSR and no hydration. Theme: one light theme only (theme.css:7), data-theme is static in index.html, no dark mode and no prefers-color-scheme use, so no theme flash can occur. Language content: main.tsx awaits loadDictionary(storedLanguage()) before createRoot, and LocaleProvider initialises state lazily from storage (locale-context.tsx initialLanguage), so German users never see English text first; they see a blank body (bg-background) until the German chunk (184 KB raw, 45.6 KB gzip) arrives. One small real flash: <html lang> is static "en" in index.html and is only set to the stored language in a useEffect (locale-context.tsx useEffect on language), after first paint. First paint for German users therefore has lang=en, which affects hyphens-auto text (editor-parts.tsx:127, tour-booking-list.tsx:117, product-rows.tsx:96, step-shell.tsx:208, transaction-list.tsx:147) and screen readers. Cosmetic, German returning visitors only, merchant and account screens mostly.
proposed_action: fix: in main.tsx set document.documentElement.lang = storedLanguage() before createRoot (one line). Optional, not urgent
